items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: via Muggsy Spanier and bands of that ilk... found out that I could get the sound the whole way through a record... That started my interest in the New Orleans style.

ctx.x: And did you hear jazz when you were growing up? Did you have any musicians in your family or anything?

My father, at one stage, won the Queensland Band Cornet Solo Championship. He was a relatively good musician, I'd say. I, at some stage of the game, when very small, can remember listening to Dixieland and having it appeal to me, not really knowing quite what it was. It was a pseudo type, I'd say. And soon, via Muggsy Spanier and bands of that ilk, the Bobcats, found out that I could get the sound the whole way through a record, not just parts of it. And that started my interest in the New Orleans style.
You came back through the Chicago and the Dixieland, I hope, people, to the New Orleans.
